sources.title: GitHub - Jaskaran3010/so101-act-policy
sources.snippet: This project demonstrates the complete robotics learning pipeline from calibration to real-world deployment. The SO-101 follower arm learns to recognize, grasp, and place objects using an ACT policy trained on 233 demonstration episodes collected via teleoperation.
